newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Holyman in A$49.1 mln pref share issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Holyman in A$49.1 mln pref share issue.

text.p: Australian shipping group Holyman Ltd said on Tuesday it planned a A$49.1 million converting preference shares issue to partly fund its acquisition of Union Shipping Group.
Holyman said the prospectus offered a one for six entitlements issue to holders of ordinary shares on August 12, 1997 at an issue price of A$4.50 per converting share.
Conversion would be on or before August 31, 2001.
The shares would pay fully franked dividends of eight percent of the issue price, starting on February 28, 1998 and paid half yearly.
The preference shares would convert into between one and 4.5 Holyman ordinary shares.
Shareholder approval for the issue would be sought at an extraordinary general meeting on July 30, 1997.
Holyman agreed last month to buy the Australian shipping business of Union Shipping group for A$58.3 million, plus adjustments estimated at A$7 million, from Brierley Investments Ltd.
Holyman said the acquisition was conditional on raising funds through the preference share issue.
